blocks.text:
Set out early in the morning for the Angra dos Reis region.

The drive from Rio takes approximately 2.5 hours.

On arrival, take a boat trip among the tropical islands.

The Costa Verde region is known for the bays, islands and beaches along the Atlantic coast of Rio de Janeiro state.

During the boat trip, you will see turquoise water, islands and coastal scenery.

Beach stops are planned.

You can swim and snorkel.

Catering is included on board.

The full excursion day lasts approximately 10 hours.

Dinner at the hotel after returning to Rio.
